classes.label: Code Repository
classes.comment: A source code repository surfaced via the GitHub ecosystem search endpoint.

classes.label: Code Repository Observation
classes.comment: A point-in-time observation of mutable engagement counters (stars, forks, watchers) for a code repository.

classes.label: Repository Owner
classes.comment: The owner (user or organization) of a GitHub repository, represented as a typed node rather than an opaque object.

classes.label: Topic
classes.comment: A curated topic label attached to a repository.

classes.label: Programming Language
classes.comment: A programming language associated with a repository.

classes.label: Institution
classes.comment: An institution linked to a repository, sourced from institution_infos.

classes.label: Strategic Tag
classes.comment: A strategic classification tag applied to a repository.

objectProperties.label: has owner
objectProperties.comment: Links a repository to its owner.

objectProperties.label: has topic
objectProperties.comment: Links a repository to one of its declared topics.

objectProperties.label: has language
objectProperties.comment: Links a repository to a programming language it uses.

objectProperties.label: has institution
objectProperties.comment: Links a repository to an associated institution.

objectProperties.label: has strategic tag
objectProperties.comment: Links a repository to a strategic tag identifier.

datatypeProperties.label: title
datatypeProperties.comment: Stable display title of the repository.

datatypeProperties.label: country code
datatypeProperties.comment: ISO country code associated with the repository, when available.

datatypeProperties.label: introduction
datatypeProperties.comment: Descriptive introduction / README summary text for the repository.

datatypeProperties.label: published at
datatypeProperties.comment: Date the repository was originally published.

datatypeProperties.label: star count
datatypeProperties.comment: Mutable count of stars at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: fork count
datatypeProperties.comment: Mutable count of forks at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: watch count
datatypeProperties.comment: Mutable count of watchers at observation time.

approval.rationale: Stable identifiers (title, url, country_code, introduction, published_at) and the owner object are bound to the CodeRepository entity; mutable engagement counters (star_count, fork_count, watch_count) are bound to CodeRepositoryObservation. Array-valued semantic fields (topics, languages, institution_infos, strategic_tag_ids) and the nested owner object are promoted to typed relation targets rather than opaque JSON strings, with empty targetIdPath/targetLabelPath where the source contract does not expose nested keys, preserving unknown values conservatively.
